export interface BackgroundTaskCommandRequest {
    source: Required<ActionReference>;
    subject: ActionSubject;
    command: BackgroundTaskCommand;
}

export interface BackgroundTaskCommandResult {
    role: BackgroundTaskCommand["role"];
    output: unknown;
}

export interface BackgroundTaskDecideRequest {
    source: Required<ActionReference>;
    subject: ActionSubject;
    decision: string;
    role: BackgroundTaskAnswer["role"];
    note?: string;
    review_version?: string;
}

export interface BackgroundTaskDecideResult {
    role: BackgroundTaskAnswer["role"];
    output: unknown;
}

export interface BackgroundTaskHeldReview extends Omit<BackgroundTaskDecision, "reference" | "answers"> {
    reference: ReviewReference;
    review_html: string;
    answers: Array<{
        role: "approve" | "reject";
    }>;
}

export interface BackgroundTaskRow extends Omit<BackgroundTask, "decisions" | "held_reviews"> {
    decisions: Array<BackgroundTaskDecision | BackgroundTaskHeldReview>;
    id: string;
    source: Required<ActionReference>;
    origin: BackgroundTaskCollection["source"];
}

export interface BackgroundTasksReadResult {
    tasks: BackgroundTaskRow[];
    issues: MainlineIssue[];
}

export interface HomeBackgroundTaskRow extends BackgroundTaskRow {
    project_id: string;
    project_name: string;
}

export interface HomeBackgroundTasksReadResult {
    tasks: HomeBackgroundTaskRow[];
    issues: Array<{
        project_id: string;
        source: Required<ActionReference> | null;
        code: string;
    }>;
}

export interface MainlineCounts {
    task_items?: Array<{
        subject: ActionSubject;
        item_id: string;
    }>;
    items: Record<string, {
        waiting: number;
        running: number;
    }>;
    groups: Record<string, {
        waiting: number;
        running: number;
    }>;
}

export interface MainlineGroup {
    group_id: string;
    default?: MainlineGroupDefault;
    name?: string;
    items: Array<{
        item_id: string;
        pinned: boolean;
    }>;
}

export type MainlineGroupDefault = "now" | "next" | "waiting";

export type MainlineGroupEditRequest = {
    expected_revision: string;
} & ({
    op: "add";
    name: string;
    index?: number;
} | {
    op: "rename";
    group_id: string;
    name: string;
} | {
    op: "delete";
    group_id: string;
} | {
    op: "move";
    group_id: string;
    index: number;
});

                surface: {
                    pattern: string;
                    minLength: 1;
                    type: "string";
                };
                title: {
                    readonly minLength: 1;
                    readonly type: "string";
                };
                icon: {
                    pattern: string;
                    minLength: 1;
                    type: "string";
                };
            };
            required: string[];
            additionalProperties: boolean;
        };
        wing: {
            enum: string[];
        };
        rank: {
            readonly type: "integer";
            readonly minimum: 0;
        };
        line_state: {
            enum: readonly ("partial" | "idle" | "connected" | "ready" | "running" | "doing" | "starting" | "generating" | "saving" | "indexing" | "done" | "saved" | "round-ended" | "staged" | "waiting" | "queued" | "answer" | "approval" | "reauth" | "paused" | "stopped" | "cancelled" | "disabled" | "blocked" | "unavailable" | "quarantined" | "syncing" | "retrying" | "failed" | "interrupted" | "verify" | "conflict" | "stale" | "disconnected" | "unsaved" | "draft" | "unstaged" | "untracked" | "unread" | "read" | "archived" | "material" | "trashed")[];
        };
        waiting: {
            type: string;
        };
        suggestion: {
            readonly type: "object";
            readonly properties: {
                readonly text: {
                    readonly type: "string";
                    readonly minLength: 1;
                    readonly maxLength: 200;
                };
                readonly waiting_on: {
                    readonly type: "string";
                    readonly minLength: 1;
                    readonly maxLength: 200;
                };
                readonly start: {
                    readonly type: "object";
                    readonly properties: {
                        readonly action: {
                            readonly required: readonly ["capability_id", "version", "provider_id"];
                            readonly type: "object";
                            readonly properties: {
                                readonly capability_id: {
                                    readonly type: "string";
                                    readonly minLength: 1;
                                };
                                readonly version: {
                                    readonly type: "integer";
                                    readonly minimum: 1;
                                };
                                readonly provider_id: {
                                    readonly type: "string";
                                    readonly minLength: 1;
                                };
                            };
                            readonly additionalProperties: false;
                        };
                        readonly input: {
                            readonly type: "object";
                        };
                    };
                    readonly required: readonly ["action", "input"];
                    readonly additionalProperties: false;
                };
            };
            readonly required: readonly ["text"];
            readonly additionalProperties: false;
        };
        tasks: {
            type: string;
            properties: {
                running: {
                    readonly type: "integer";
                    readonly minimum: 0;
                };
                waiting: {
                    readonly type: "integer";
                    readonly minimum: 0;
                };
                refs: {
                    type: string;
                    items: {
                        readonly type: "object";
                        readonly properties: {
                            readonly kind: {
                                readonly type: "string";
                                readonly minLength: 1;
                            };
                            readonly id: {
                                readonly type: "string";
                                readonly minLength: 1;
                            };
                        };
                        readonly required: readonly ["kind", "id"];
                        readonly additionalProperties: false;
                    };
                };
            };
            required: string[];
            additionalProperties: boolean;
        };
        event_id: {
            readonly minLength: 1;
            readonly type: "string";
        };
        subject: {
            readonly type: "object";
            readonly properties: {
                readonly kind: {
                    readonly type: "string";
                    readonly minLength: 1;
                };
                readonly id: {
                    readonly type: "string";
                    readonly minLength: 1;
                };
            };
            readonly required: readonly ["kind", "id"];
            readonly additionalProperties: false;
        };
        occurred_at: {
            readonly format: "date-time";
            readonly minLength: 1;
            readonly type: "string";
        };
        scheduled_at: {
            readonly format: "date-time";
            readonly minLength: 1;
            readonly type: "string";
        };
        state: {
            enum: readonly ("partial" | "idle" | "connected" | "ready" | "running" | "doing" | "starting" | "generating" | "saving" | "indexing" | "done" | "saved" | "round-ended" | "staged" | "waiting" | "queued" | "answer" | "approval" | "reauth" | "paused" | "stopped" | "cancelled" | "disabled" | "blocked" | "unavailable" | "quarantined" | "syncing" | "retrying" | "failed" | "interrupted" | "verify" | "conflict" | "stale" | "disconnected" | "unsaved" | "draft" | "unstaged" | "untracked" | "unread" | "read" | "archived" | "material" | "trashed")[];
        };
        placement: {
            enum: string[];
        };
        category: {
            enum: string[];
        };
        title: {
            readonly minLength: 1;
            readonly type: "string";
        };
        summary: {
            readonly type: "string";
        };
        content: {
            readonly type: "string";
        };
        facts: {
            type: string;
            items: {
                type: string;
                items: {
                    readonly type: "string";
                };
                minItems: number;
                maxItems: number;
            };
        };
        needs_attention: {
            type: string;
        };
        open: {
            anyOf: ({
                readonly type: "object";
                readonly properties: {
                    readonly kind: {
                        readonly enum: readonly ["item", "group", "surface"];
                    };
                    readonly surface: {
                        pattern: string;
                        minLength: 1;
                        type: "string";
                    };
                    readonly id: {
                        readonly type: readonly ["string", "null"];
                        readonly minLength: 1;
                    };
                    readonly title: {
                        readonly minLength: 1;
                        readonly type: "string";
                    };
                    readonly label: {
                        readonly minLength: 1;
                        readonly type: "string";
                    };
                };
                readonly required: readonly ["kind", "surface", "id", "title", "label"];
                readonly additionalProperties: false;
                readonly anyOf: readonly [{
                    readonly properties: {
                        readonly kind: {
                            readonly const: "surface";
                        };
                        readonly id: {
                            readonly type: "null";
                        };
                    };
                }, {
                    readonly properties: {
                        readonly kind: {
                            readonly enum: readonly ["item", "group"];
                        };
                        readonly id: {
                            readonly minLength: 1;
                            readonly type: "string";
                        };
                    };
                }];
            } | {
                type: string;
            })[];
        };
    };
    required: string[];
    type: string;
    additionalProperties: boolean;
};

export interface WaitingItem {
    subject: ActionSubject;
    source: "event" | "task";
    event_id?: string;
    task?: ActionSubject;
    since: string;
    open: OpenTarget | null;
}

export interface WaitingReadResult {
    items: WaitingItem[];
    counts: {
        total: number;
    };
    issues: MainlineIssue[];
}

export interface WorkItem {
    item_id: string;
    name?: string;
    source?: ActionSubject;
    created_at: string;
}

export interface WorkLineEvent extends WorkEvent {
    id: string;
    source: Required<ActionReference>;
    origin: WorkEventCollection["source"];
    wing: "done" | "now" | "next";
    rank: number;
    line_state?: StateRingState;
    waiting: boolean;
    tasks: {
        running: number;
        waiting: number;
        refs: ActionSubject[];
    };
    suggestion?: WorkItemNextStep;
}

export type WorkLineReadRequest = WorkEventWindow & {
    item?: string;
};

export interface WorkLineReadResult {
    events: WorkLineEvent[];
    table: BackgroundTasksReadResult;
    issues: MainlineIssue[];
}

export declare const mainlineActions: {
    line: ActionDefinition<WorkLineReadRequest, WorkLineReadResult>;
    waiting: ActionDefinition<WorkEventWindow, WaitingReadResult>;
    place: ActionDefinition<TaskPlaceRequest, TaskPlaceResult>;
    tasks: ActionDefinition<Record<string, never>, BackgroundTasksReadResult>;
    command: ActionDefinition<BackgroundTaskCommandRequest, BackgroundTaskCommandResult>;
    open: ActionDefinition<ObjectOpenRequest, ObjectOpenResult>;
    decide: ActionDefinition<BackgroundTaskDecideRequest, BackgroundTaskDecideResult>;
};

export declare const mainlineErrors: import("platform/action-errors").ErrorCodeRaisers<{
    readonly source_changed: "conflict";
    readonly task_changed: "conflict";
    readonly decision_changed: "conflict";
    readonly note_invalid: "invalid";
    readonly task_not_placeable: "invalid";
    readonly relation_ambiguous: "conflict";
    readonly event_unreadable: "not_found";
    readonly owner_answer_invalid: "upstream";
    readonly conflict: "conflict";
    readonly limit: "too_large";
    readonly item_missing: "not_found";
    readonly subject_unreadable: "not_found";
    readonly source_unavailable: "unavailable";
}>;

export declare const mainlineItemActions: {
    read: ActionDefinition<MainlineReadRequest, MainlineReadResult>;
    subject: ActionDefinition<import("platform/action-subjects").SubjectContextRequest, import("platform/action-subjects").ActionSubjectContext>;
    create: ActionDefinition<MainlineItemCreateRequest, MainlineItemResult>;
    convert: ActionDefinition<MainlineItemConvertRequest, MainlineItemResult>;

    groups: ActionDefinition<MainlineGroupEditRequest, MainlineResult>;
    switch: ActionDefinition<MainlineSwitchRequest, MainlineResult>;
    contents: ActionDefinition<MainlineContentsRequest, MainlineContentsResult>;
    holdsList: ActionDefinition<import("platform/placement").PlacementRelationSubjectInput, import("platform/placement").PlacementRelationResult>;
    holdsBind: ActionDefinition<import("platform/placement").PlacementRelationBindInput, import("platform/placement").PlacementRelationResult>;
    holdsRelease: ActionDefinition<import("platform/placement").PlacementRelationTargetInput, import("platform/placement").PlacementRelationResult>;
    holdsCandidates: ActionDefinition<import("platform/placement").PlacementRelationSubjectInput, import("platform/placement").PlacementRelationCandidates>;

};
